groups.sentence: Other courses and instructors may have different AI policies, so students should check expectations for each course.
Instructors tell students that AI policies differ between courses and write course-specific policy statements.
Students face varying AI policies across courses and may wrongly assume other courses' rules apply in an instructor's course.
Students conform to the AI expectations of each course they take.
This course's AI policy applies only to this course.
Students must not treat AI permission granted in one course or assignment as approval to use AI elsewhere.
Permitted uses of generative AI may change over time.
AI rules and permitted uses vary between courses, instructors and assignments; what is acceptable in one may be a violation in another.
